ambiguousAlternatives.note: A1 also addresses the stethoscope but is an incomplete version of A4 that omits surface disinfection and supply assessment, making it a contraindicated subset rather than a genuine competitor; A3 was selected because it adds non-overlapping system-level correction.

P2 is the only remaining parameter tied to precaution adherence, though it monitors room-entry behavior rather than the clean utility area itself; the pool contains no clean-utility audit or MRSA surveillance option, so P2 is the best available second parameter rather than an ideal match.

reasoning: The stem asks for the priority cross-contamination problem. C1 names the only actual, in-progress contamination event: a stethoscope carried out of an MRSA contact-precautions room is sitting in the clean utility room beside a clean supply cart, so clean stock destined for multiple clients is currently exposed. C2 is explicitly framed in the stem as a 'concern' requiring policy verification and C3 is a localized, already-identified surface contamination limited to one door handle; both are narrower and neither involves breach of the clean/dirty boundary in a shared supply area, so they rank below C1 on actual-over-potential and number-affected priority rules. Among actions, A4 is the complete source-control response — remove the device, disinfect contacted clean-utility surfaces, address nearby supplies per policy, observe the disinfectant wet-contact time, and restore the device to its designated isolation room. A3 is the system-level complement: immediate corrective education plus leadership notification so the breach is documented for infection-control follow-up. A1 is a partial intervention that leaves the counter and adjacent supplies contaminated, and A2 defers an active contamination hazard; both are contraindicated rather than merely lower priority. For parameters, P3 directly evaluates whether the corrective action held: equipment location and cleanliness checked at each room entry confirms the device stays dedicated to the isolation room and is disinfected. P2 evaluates ongoing contact-precautions adherence by visitors and staff at subsequent entries, the behavior whose failure produced the breach. P1 and P4 are distractors — antimicrobial monitoring is a treatment parameter unrelated to the contamination event, and a sputum culture belongs to the separate TB/AIIR thread in the stem. No client-specific facts were inferred; selection rests on stem text and general infection-control knowledge.
